what: a loft through 19 identical 6 x 4 rectangles on planes turning about the Z axis every 10 degrees from 0 to 180 degrees, centred 30 mm from the axis (volume came out 6 % of the expected at 180 degrees, no error)
method: every section is in a half-plane through the Z axis with its centroid at distance 30, so the loft is a bent bar of constant section: Pappus V = A * R * theta = 24 * 30 * pi. bbox: the rectangle reaches radius 33 at 0, 90 and 180 degrees and z = +-2.
